description:
The Lineage Master was created to take a DNA strand or two from our past and thread it into state of the art contemporary designs of the present. Look at this masterpiece, from a glance its difficult to tell from the original 30 years prior. But when you look closely, you will see all modern technology. Investment cast dropouts, Mid BB, internal headset. Forks are full heat treated and butted same as the Kneesaver bars and Fusion Alloy 22mm cranks. This bike is as high level BMX you are going to buy in todays market.
100% chromoly Lineage Team Bashguard Master frame with twin top tube, removable brake hardware, Mid BB shell, integrated head tube and Lineage cast dropouts with integrated chain tensioners 22.5" top tube length
100% heat treated chromoly Lineage fork, integrated bearing race, tapered legs and 990 brake mounts with internal brake cable routing
100% heat treated and butted chromoly Lineage Kneesaver bars 8.5" with Haro Lineage CNC alloy top load stem
Fusion 7075 alloy heat treated 3-piece crank with chromoly spindle 175mm with Haro Lineage Compact Disc 41T CNC alloy bolt drive sprocket and sealed Mid BB
41/17 gearing
Fully sealed wheels with Lineage high flange hubs and double-wall alloy rims, Kenda tires 26 x 2.25" front and rear
Haro Lineage padded Pivotal seat with alloy Lineage Pivotal fluted post
Fusion alloy pedals
CNC alloy pegs
CNC alloy gyro with Teflon bearing
Haro Team grips
KMC K710SL super light chain
Dia-Compe "Hombre" FS996 brakes with Tech 77 levers front and rear
Fusion alloy twin torque seat post clamp
80 models produced
